evidence.quote: For 2025-03-31 staging has Investments=308031000, Investments United States Investments and Cash Equivalents=315009000, and Investments United States Cash Equivalents=6978000; holdings included two cash-equivalent rows totaling 6978000.
Across quarters, fv residual equals cash-equivalent FV exactly in 2023-12-31, 2024-09-30, and 2024-12-31, confirming the anchor is investments-only while holdings included cash equivalents.

rationale: The conservation anchor is the filer's investments-at-fair-value subtotal, not investments plus cash equivalents. Cash-equivalent holdings are real liquidity rows, but they are outside this investments-only anchor and should not be counted in the fair-value conservation sum.
